host.title: Local IP of Daikin Air Purifier

username.title: Daikin Account Email
username.description: The email you sign in to the Daikin Smart App with. Needed to control the purifier; leave empty for read-only.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Needed to control the purifier. Captured once from the Daikin Smart App's https://api.daikinsmartdb.jp/premise/dsiot/login request body.

terminalId.title: Terminal ID
terminalId.description: Needed to control the purifier. Captured once from the Daikin Smart App's https://api.daikinsmartdb.jp/cleaner/set_control_info request.

port.title: Port
port.description: Needed to control the purifier. Usually 30050; it is also shown as port= at http://<purifier IP>/common/basic_info.

clientId.title: Client ID (advanced)
clientId.description: Leave empty to use the Daikin Smart App's client ID.

uuid.title: App UUID (advanced)
uuid.description: Leave empty to have the plugin generate one.

code.title: Authorization Code (advanced)
code.description: Alternative to email and password: a code captured from the Daikin Smart App. It works a single time.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token (advanced)
refreshToken.description: Alternative to email and password: a refresh_token captured from the Daikin Smart App.

cacheDuration.title: Cache Duration (seconds)
cacheDuration.description: How often the purifier is polled on the local network.
